changelog:
feishu-project-api 1.0.0

- Initial release providing access to 飞书项目 (Feishu Project) Open API
- Supports full lifecycle management: querying, creating, updating, deleting, aborting/restoring work items
- Includes workflow template management, node/step configuration, custom fields, view management, and role permissions
- Batch opportunity (商机) progress and risk analysis with structured report output
- Enables bulk operations on tasks and advanced workflow/field/template operations
- Detailed API usage and best practices documented for quick start and troubleshooting
summary: 飞书项目Open API技能，查询/创建/更新/删除工作项，管理流程模板、节点配置、自定义字段、视图和角色权限，批量分析商机进度与风险。触发：查商机、分析进度、管理工作项模板、批量更新任务、流程配置。
